title: About PRAKRITI-NETRA
subtitle: The Satellite Eye for India's Forests, Water & Wildlife • Code for Innovex '26

mission.heading: Why Alerts, Not Just Maps?
mission.body: Traditional conservation platforms provide beautiful static maps, but maps do not stop chainsaws or save drying wetlands. PRAKRITI-NETRA shifts the paradigm from passive monitoring to automated, proactive alerting. By continuously running change-detection algorithms over Sentinel and NASA open satellite feeds, we deliver targeted, geocoded alerts straight to range officers before damage becomes irreversible.

roadmap.heading: Product Evolution Roadmap
roadmap.nowDesc: Kudremukh Western Ghats reserve pilot; Sentinel-2 & SAR bi-temporal canopy change detection; Telegram field alert dispatch; mock & live API integration.
roadmap.nextDesc: Automated Copernicus weekly ingestion cron; offline SMS alerts for remote beats without 4G; drone coordinate dispatch for high-confidence anomalies.
roadmap.laterDesc: Pan-India coverage of 106 National Parks & 573 Wildlife Sanctuaries; citizen ground-truthing portal; on-orbit satellite edge AI inference.

tour.step1Desc: Welcome to Prakriti-Netra. We monitor high-biodiversity ecosystems using Copernicus Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar satellites.
tour.step2Desc: Instead of waiting for 2-year survey cycles, our automated pipeline flags sudden canopy loss and fires as soon as a satellite passes overhead.
tour.step3Desc: Track lake water spread contraction and groundwater depletion to protect wetlands before drinking water crises emerge.
tour.step4Desc: Review flagged alerts with Before/After satellite imagery, confirm status, and dispatch instant GPS alerts to field patrol officers via Telegram.
